regions.name: The Crossroads
regions.description: A leaning signpost, a dead fire, and crows that watch a little too closely.

regions.name: Ashen Marsh
regions.description: Fog, iron, and things that breathe under the water.

regions.name: Whispering Woods
regions.description: The trees murmur your name. None of them should know it.

regions.name: The Old Mine
regions.description: Rotten beams, rusted picks, and a smell of something that never left.

regions.name: Drowned Chapel
regions.description: Half-sunk pews and a bell that rings with no one to pull it.

regions.name: Barrow Hills
regions.description: Ancient graves, all open. Whatever slept here is awake now.
